local sub = string.sub

local SYMBOLS = "abcdefgh"

local function huffman_total(text)
    local freq = {}
    for i = 1, #text do
        local ch = sub(text, i, i)
        freq[ch] = (freq[ch] or 0) + 1
    end

    -- Fixed symbol order makes ties in the minimum scan deterministic.
    local nodes = {}
    for i = 1, 8 do
        local ch = sub(SYMBOLS, i, i)
        if freq[ch] then
            nodes[#nodes + 1] = { freq[ch], ch }
        end
    end

    local function find_min()
        local best = -1
        for i = 1, #nodes do
            if best < 0 or nodes[i][1] < nodes[best][1] then
                best = i
            end
        end
        return best
    end

    while #nodes > 1 do
        local first = find_min()
        local left = table.remove(nodes, first)
        local second = find_min()
        local right = table.remove(nodes, second)
        nodes[#nodes + 1] = { left[1] + right[1], { left, right } }
    end

    local function total_length(node, depth)
        if type(node[2]) == "string" then
            return node[1] * depth
        end
        return total_length(node[2][1], depth + 1) +
            total_length(node[2][2], depth + 1)
    end

    return total_length(nodes[1], 0)
end

local seed = 42
local chars = {}
for _ = 1, 40000 do
    seed = (seed * 1103515245 + 12345) % 2147483648
    chars[#chars + 1] = sub(SYMBOLS, seed % 8 + 1, seed % 8 + 1)
end
local text = table.concat(chars)

local started = os.clock()
local result = huffman_total(text)
local elapsed = math.floor((os.clock() - started) * 1e9 + 0.5)

print(result)
print(elapsed)

import time
from heapq import heappop, heappush


def dijkstra(graph, source, size):
    dist = [1000000000000] * size
    dist[source] = 0
    queue = [(0, source)]
    while queue:
        distance, vertex = heappop(queue)
        if distance != dist[vertex]:
            continue
        for target, weight in graph.get(vertex, ()):
            alternative = distance + weight
            if alternative < dist[target]:
                dist[target] = alternative
                heappush(queue, (alternative, target))
    return dist


size = 250
degree = 6
graph = {}
for i in range(size):
    edges = []
    edges.append([(i + 1) % size, 1])
    for k in range(degree):
        j = (i * 7 + k * 13 + 3) % size
        w = (i * 5 + k * 11 + 7) % 19 + 1
        edges.append([j, w])
    graph[i] = edges
sources = [0, size // 4, size // 2, size * 3 // 4]
rounds = 4

def bench():
    started = time.process_time_ns()
    checksum = 0
    for round in range(rounds):
        for s in range(len(sources)):
            dist = dijkstra(graph, sources[s], size)
            checksum += sum(dist)
    elapsed = time.process_time_ns() - started

    print(checksum)
    print(elapsed)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    bench()

local function merge_sort(values)
    local n = #values
    if n <= 1 then
        return table.move(values, 1, n, 1, {})
    end

    local middle = n // 2
    local left_slice = table.move(values, 1, middle, 1, {})
    local right_slice = table.move(values, middle + 1, n, 1, {})
    local left = merge_sort(left_slice)
    local right = merge_sort(right_slice)
    local merged = {}
    local i = 1
    local j = 1
    local k = 0

    while i <= #left and j <= #right do
        k = k + 1
        if left[i] <= right[j] then
            merged[k] = left[i]
            i = i + 1
        else
            merged[k] = right[j]
            j = j + 1
        end
    end
    table.move(left, i, #left, k + 1, merged)
    k = k + #left - i + 1
    table.move(right, j, #right, k + 1, merged)
    return merged
end
